_comment: Pins that a ballot set cast entirely by weight-0 participants is the EMPTY DECISIVE TALLY, and that this state is NoVotes rather than Failed, so BOTH commitment directions are denied under schema_version 3 (RFC-MACP-0012 4.1; RFC-MACP-0007 6.2). The negative arm is the load-bearing one: it is the assertion that distinguishes NoVotes from Failed, which differ only in the negative direction. Paired with decision_weighted_zero_weight_v1.json, which is the same transcript at schema_version 1 and diverges only in the POSITIVE direction.
description: Decision Mode: weight-0 ballots are non-decisive; zero total decisive weight is NoVotes under schema_version 3.

policy.description: Weighted vote over a one-member electorate, initiator-only commitment, schema_version 3 fail-closed empty-tally semantics.

messages._comment: A weight-0 vote is NON-DECISIVE under 'weighted' at EVERY schema_version (RFC-MACP-0012 4.1, weighted electorate rule): it is accepted as a message and preserved in history, but contributes to neither side of the ratio, does not enter the decisive tally, and does not satisfy the decline guard of RFC-MACP-0007 6.2. 'agent://b' is a declared participant absent from the weights map, so its weight is 0.

ARBITRATING ASSERTION. The only REJECT on this tally was cast by a weight-0 participant, so it is non-decisive and the decline guard is NOT satisfied: the state is NoVotes, not Failed (RFC-MACP-0012 4.1, Empty tally, weighted bullet; RFC-MACP-0007 6.2). A reading that treated zero total decisive weight as Failed would ALLOW this negative commitment. It is denied.

payload.reason: negative commitment attempted with only a weight-0 REJECT on the tally

messages._comment: Total decisive weight is zero, which IS the empty decisive tally. Under schema_version 3 every algorithm other than 'none' fails on it, so the positive commitment is denied too. An implementation MUST NOT compute a weighted ratio with a zero denominator.

payload.reason: positive commitment attempted at zero total decisive weight

messages._comment: UNLOCK PROOF. 'agent://a' carries weight 1, so this ballot is decisive and the tally becomes non-empty: approve share 1/1 >= threshold 0.5.

payload.reason: weighted approval by the full decisive electorate
